answer_1.quote: In this work, we take a step towards controllable generation of mathematically consistent MWPs with high language quality. ... We formulate the task of controllable MWP generation as a conditional generation problem.
answer_1.outputs: Generated math word problems (MWPs) conditioned on an equation and context
